'''Omar Berenko''' was a famous and controversial [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] poet who was the former owner of the country house at [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] centuries before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. He was mysteriously kidnapped by unknown attackers at the same spot where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were secretly wed at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was never seen or heard from again. Of Berenko's most famous works, his poem, "[[Defense of Naboo/Legends|Defense of Naboo]]," was considered by many to be disturbing yet imaginative.
